Upon arriving at Summer Training Camp, El 
Condor Pasa learns of a local festival 
where people dance wearing masks.

Feeling the true spirit of La Mascarada in 
the mask and dance, El Condor Pasa got 
super hyped and enthusiastically vowed 
that she would definitely join the 
festival.

Though it took an unexpected turn... this 
year's passionate Summer Camp with El 
Condor Pasa has officially begun!
